DisplayTitle.Name: Display name in actor header?
DisplayTitle.Hint: If unchecked will only display icon for Pathmuncher in the actors header bar.

Reset.Title: Reset settings to default
Reset.Label: Reset Pathmuncher Settings
Reset.Hint: This will reset all of the module's settings back to their defaults.

RestrictToTrusted.Name: Restrict Import to trusted users?
RestrictToTrusted.Hint: Only trusted users will be able to import

AddVisionFeats.Name: Add vision feats?
AddVisionFeats.Hint: If selected, Darkvision and Low-Light Vision will be added as feats to character sheet. Doesn't affect sense values.

LogLevel.Name: Log Level
LogLevel.Hint: The level of logs to place into the console.

UseCustomCompendiumMappings.Title: Use custom compendium mappings?
UseCustomCompendiumMappings.Label: Custom Compendium Mappings
UseCustomCompendiumMappings.Hint: This is useful for things like Battlezoo or Cleric+ modules, or even if you have your own compendium of custom feats.

ResetSettings.Title: Pathmuncher | Reset Settings
ResetSettings.Content: Are you sure you want to reset all of the Pathmuncher module settings' to their defaults?

Pathmuncher.FetchFailed: Unable to fetch a character with Pathbuilder id {pathbuilderId}!
Pathmuncher.FetchError: Unable to reach Pathbuilder for id {pathbuilderId}. Check the id, or export the character as JSON and paste it instead.
Pathmuncher.InvalidBuild: This does not look like a Pathbuilder export, so nothing was changed. Paste the JSON from Pathbuilder's "Export JSON" option.
Pathmuncher.ProcessingFailed: Pathmuncher could not process this character, so nothing was changed: {error}

FreeArchetype.BuildOnly: This character was built with Free Archetype, but the variant is off in this world, so archetype feats are put in class feat slots where there is room. Turn on Free Archetype in the system settings before importing to keep them in archetype slots.
FreeArchetype.WorldOnly: Free Archetype is on in this world, but this character was built without it, so its archetype slots will be empty.

GradualBoosts.BuildOnly: This character was built with gradual ability boosts, but the variant is off in this world, so boosts taken since the last 5-level step will not apply. Turn on Gradual Ability Boosts in the system settings before importing.
GradualBoosts.WorldOnly: Gradual ability boosts are on in this world, but this character was built without them; check its ability boosts after importing.

Pathmuncher.UpdateFailed: Pathmuncher failed while updating {actor}: {error}. A copy of the character from before the import was saved as "{backup}".

MissingCore.Title: Pathmuncher | Missing from compendiums
MissingCore.Content: Pathmuncher could not find these in any compendium it searches. Drag the right one from a compendium or the Items directory onto its box, or click the box to open the compendium. Any left empty are skipped and listed in the import report.
MissingCore.Drop: Drop the {type} here, or click to open its compendium
MissingCore.WrongType: That item is not of type {type}.

DeityConflict.Title: Pathmuncher | Deity choices
DeityConflict.Content: Pathbuilder allowed choices this deity does not grant its followers, so the system would ask for them again. Keep the deity and pick choices it allows, or keep your choices and pick a deity that allows them all. Hover over an option for details.

Conflicts.cause: The {cause} cause needs {sanctification} sanctification, which {deity} does not allow.

DeityConflict.KeepDeityHint: and replace the choices it does not allow
DeityConflict.KeepChoicesHint: and follow a deity that allows them all ({count} found)
DeityConflict.NoOptions: The deity allows nothing else here.
DeityConflict.NoDeities: No deity in the searched compendiums allows all of these choices. You can still drop one.
DeityConflict.Drop: Drop a deity here, or click to open the compendium
DeityConflict.WrongType: That item is not a deity.
DeityConflict.StillConflicts: {deity} still does not allow {count} of these choices; the system will ask for them during the import.

EidolonBuilder.Title: Pathmuncher | Eidolon
EidolonBuilder.Hint: Pathbuilder's export leaves out these choices for the eidolon. Make them here: the stat block shows the eidolon as it would be with them. Hover over an evolution feat for what it does.
EidolonBuilder.SizeSetBy: {item} makes the eidolon {size}, whatever size is picked here.
EidolonBuilder.Failed: The eidolon's choices could not be written: {error}

Companion.Title: Pathmuncher | Companion
Companion.Content: {pet} is {master}'s companion, and has no character of its own yet. Make a new character for it, or build it on one of these characters: they are blank or made for a companion, and no other player owns them.

Ammunition.Title: Pathmuncher | Ammunition
Ammunition.Content: Pathbuilder lists this ammunition once, but each of these weapons takes its own. Drag each stack onto the weapon it is for. Split a stack to share it between weapons, or add more. Stacks not given to a weapon are not imported.

UnansweredChoices.Title: Pathmuncher | Choices to make
UnansweredChoices.Content: The Pathbuilder export does not say what was chosen for these. Pick them now, or leave one unpicked and the system will ask for it during the import. Hover over an option for details.
UnansweredChoices.Taken: Already chosen on another {item}: {list}. Those are not offered here.

KeepItems.Title: Pathmuncher | Keep items added by hand?
KeepItems.Content: These items were not added by a Pathmuncher import, but are in categories this import replaces. Ticked items are kept; unticked items are deleted. Items you keep that are also in the Pathbuilder build will appear twice.

CompendiumSelector.Title: Pathmuncher | Compendium lookups
CompendiumSelector.Intro: Choose which compendiums Pathmuncher searches for each kind of item, and in what order. The first compendium with a match wins.
CompendiumSelector.Empty: Choose an item kind to edit its compendiums.

Report.Title: Pathmuncher | Import notes
Report.Intro: Pathmuncher could not match these to a Foundry item. They may be named differently in the compendiums, so try a manual search. Specials are Pathbuilder notes that may be a choice already made on another item, or need nothing in Foundry.
Report.DescribedHint: Pathbuilder lists these on their own. In Foundry they are a section of the feature shown: hover over a name to read it, or click the feature to open it.
Report.RulesHint: Pathmuncher could not work out these items' choices or granted items from the build, so Foundry applied the rules itself. Check each item for anything it asked about or added. Where the build chose an option Foundry doesn't offer, the build's choice is shown in brackets.
Report.PetsHint: Pathmuncher imports familiars, and animal companions and a summoner's eidolon when the PF2e Companion Compendia module is active. Create these from the build by hand.
Report.CompanionChoicesHint: Pathbuilder's export leaves out these choices for companions and eidolons, so the import made them. Change any that are wrong on the companion's items; the next import keeps them.

Importer.Title: Import from Pathbuilder

id.Label: Export ID
id.Hint: In Pathbuilder, open the menu and choose Export JSON, then enter the ID it shows.

json.Label: Paste JSON
json.Hint: In Pathbuilder's Export JSON window, choose View JSON and paste all of it here.

file.Label: JSON file
file.Hint: Choose a .json file saved from Pathbuilder's Export JSON window.
file.Missing: Choose a Pathbuilder JSON file to import.

Importer.Problems: Something not right? Report it on Discord.

LastImport.ReuseAnswers: Re-use import answers from the last import?
LastImport.ReuseAnswersHint: Gives your answers from last time again where the same question comes up: choices, the deity, items dropped in for missing ones, and the items added by hand you kept. Anything new is still asked.

Notifications.CreateActorPermission: Pathmuncher requires the CREATE ACTOR permission for your user.
Notifications.CreateFolderError: User {userName} lacks permission to create Folder {folderName}. Enable the setting or create it manually.
Notifications.SystemChanged: Pathmuncher cannot find parts of the system it uses to work out choices from a Pathbuilder build, possibly after an update to {version}. Imports will still run, but the system will ask for more choices. Check for a Pathmuncher update.
